symptom: An authenticated administrator has no usable way to sign out from the admin interface.
expected_behavior: Every admin screen exposes a clear logout action that clears the session, shows progress, handles failure and prevents protected content from returning through reload or browser history.
environment: VII production admin and release checkout on 2026-10-15; shared /admin layout and Google session cookie authentication.

steps: Inspect the shared navigation and command bar for a logout action
reproduction.evidence: app/admin/admin-nav.tsx and app/admin/admin-command-bar.tsx contain no logout control or call to /api/auth/logout.

observations.observation: A POST logout endpoint already exists and returns a Set-Cookie header that expires vii_session.
The shared admin navigation has only an external site link in its footer.
The shared command bar contains search and work-queue actions but no logout action.

hypotheses.mechanism: The server capability is orphaned because the shared admin UI never exposes or invokes it.
hypotheses.prediction: The endpoint exists, while no admin component references it.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Search the admin component family and inspect the endpoint.
hypotheses.result: Endpoint exists; no admin UI reference or sign-out control was found.

hypotheses.mechanism: A visible logout control exists but fails because its request method or cookie attributes do not match the endpoint.
hypotheses.prediction: Admin source contains a logout button or /api/auth/logout fetch whose request or clearing cookie is malformed.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Search all admin sources for logout controls and compare secureCookie with clearCookie attributes.
hypotheses.result: No admin logout invocation exists. secureCookie and clearCookie both use Path=/, HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite=Lax.

fix.change: Added one shared admin-command-bar logout action with immediate busy feedback, duplicate prevention, localized recovery error, cookie-expiring POST, history-replacement navigation and bfcache session revalidation.
fix.evidence: Focused tests pass 6/6; production build passes; local browser QA passed the desktop logout, cookie removal, Back protection and 390px mobile touch-target checks.

regression_checks.check: Shared control on representative admin routes
regression_checks.evidence: Desktop /admin/catalog-sync and mobile /admin/search-analytics screenshots show the shared control.

regression_checks.check: Loading, duplicate prevention and recoverable failure
regression_checks.evidence: tests/admin-command-center.test.mjs and inspected command-bar component states
ADMIN_LOGOUT_BROWSER_QA_PASSED with an empty vii_session cookie and no admin URL after Back

regression_checks.check: Production compilation and Hebrew font source

remaining_unknowns: Exact live production behavior remains pending deployment and post-deploy inspection.
authorization_boundary: Repair and verify VII admin logout without changing administrator membership or provider configuration.
